findings.doc: Turns an object into an executable program by treating the object's body as its `main` method.
findings.notes: Clean one-liner: active verb, third person, present tense, no self-reference, backtick on `main`, no HTML. Consistent with the voice of other members in the file.

findings.doc: Stores the given initialization code so that it runs later when `main` is invoked. @param body the initialization code to be stored for later execution
findings.notes: @param tag starts lowercase, no trailing period. First sentence stands alone. Backtick on `main`. No @return needed (Unit). No HTML.
